## Checklist

- [ ] The diff implements the cited acceptance criteria and no unrelated work.
- [ ] Product behavior was not invented in code or tests.
- [ ] OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, JSON Schemas, documentation, and implementation agree.
- [ ] New writes are idempotent where retries are possible.
- [ ] Occupation, deterministic replay, and balanced-ledger invariants remain true.
- [ ] External data has provenance, license/permission, version, and checksum.
- [ ] Monetization changes include a no-pay-to-win equivalence analysis.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, prompts, and commits contain no secrets or personal data.
- [ ] Failure, migration, observability, and rollback behavior are tested.
- [ ] An independent agent/session reviewed the change.
